tasks.subject: Task 1: windows_emulator -- standard positioned mouse messages
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add deliver_mouse_move/deliver_mouse_button, synthesizing real positioned WM_MOUSEMOVE/WM_LBUTTONDOWN/WM_LBUTTONUP/WM_RBUTTONDOWN/WM_RBUTTONUP messages, mirroring the existing deliver_raw_mouse_input/deliver_raw_input pattern but with real coordinates instead of a WM_INPUT token.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/windows-emulator/windows_emulator.hpp
- Modify: src/windows-emulator/windows_emulator.cpp

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] deliver_mouse_move(x,y) posts WM_MOUSEMOVE with real lParam packing
- [ ] deliver_mouse_button(x,y,message,button_data=0) posts the given message with real lParam packing
- [ ] Both resolve target via process.foreground_window, matching deliver_raw_input
- [ ] windows-emulator-test builds clean, no regression in existing test pass rate

**Verify:** cmake --build --preset=release --target windows-emulator-test && EMULATOR_ROOT=<shared-root> ctest --test-dir build/release --output-on-failure -> same pass rate as before

tasks.subject: Task 2: ios_ui_backend + SogenBridge -- queue and wire new mouse events
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extend the queue-and-drain infrastructure to carry positioned move/click events alongside existing raw button/delta events, and wire both through SogenBridge to new Objective-C methods.

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/IosUiBackend.hpp
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/IosUiBackend.mm
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.h
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.mm

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Discriminated queued_input_event replaces bare pending_button_flags_ vector
- [ ] queue_mouse_delta/queue_mouse_move/queue_mouse_button added
- [ ] New mouse_move_sink/mouse_button_sink types + setters, wired in pump_events()
- [ ] queue_left_click() unchanged behavior
- [ ] New frame_size_sink + setter, invoked once per frame size change from present_surface()
- [ ] SogenEmulator gains deliverMouseMove:/deliverMouseButton:message:/deliverMouseDelta:dy:/onFrameSize
- [ ] Builds clean for default iOS variant

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **

tasks.subject: Task 3: Navigation split -- SetupView + EmulationView shell

- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/SogenApp.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] SetupView keeps all existing behavior; on successful boot, navigates to EmulationView via .navigationDestination(isPresented:)

tasks.subject: Task 4: Gesture recognizers + mouse-mode dispatch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Give EmulationView's guest-view host real gesture recognizers driving both mouse modes, replacing Task 3's placeholder with the real live guest surface.

**Files:**
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/EmulatorView.swift
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/EmulationView.swift
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.h
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/SogenBridge.mm
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/IosUiBackend.hpp
- Modify: tools/sogen-ios/Sources/Bridge/IosUiBackend.mm

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] EmulationView shows the real live guest CALayer via attachLayer
- [ ] MouseMode enum (.touchscreen/.trackpad) drives gesture behavior, starts .touchscreen
- [ ] Touchscreen mode: tap delivers move+button-down+button-up at transformed guest coordinates
- [ ] Trackpad mode: pan delivers relative deltas, separate tap delivers plain click
- [ ] Two-finger tap delivers right-click in both modes
- [ ] Press-and-hold-then-drag delivers click-and-drag in both modes
- [ ] Builds clean

**Verify:** cd tools/sogen-ios && xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project SogenIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SogenIOS -sdk iphoneos -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO build -> ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **
